assessments.rationale: ENCODE provides TF binding, open chromatin, histone marks, and RNA-seq tracks across cell types, directly supporting the requested regulatory evidence and tissue context.
assessments.source_anchor: TF ChIP-seq, ATAC-seq/DNase-seq peaks, histone marks, and RNA-seq

assessments.rationale: RegulomeDB directly scores regulatory variants and retrieves TF binding, histone, DNase, motif, eQTL, and chromatin-state evidence with an explicit strength scale.
assessments.source_anchor: retrieve overlapping evidence (TF binding, histone marks, DNase peaks, footprints, motifs, eQTLs, chromatin state)

assessments.rationale: This consumes structural quality-gate reports and does not annotate variants or retrieve regulatory genomics evidence.
This performs GSVA pathway analysis, unrelated to noncoding variant regulatory effects.
assessments.source_anchor: Use this skill to run GSVA or ssGSEA pathway-level differential analysis

assessments.rationale: This produces clinical summaries and does not retrieve TF, chromatin, motif, or eQTL evidence for variants.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: functional regulatory evidence across TF, chromatin, motif, and expression tracks
assessments.rationale: This fetches GWAS summary statistics, not functional regulatory evidence for noncoding variants.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: histone, accessibility, motif, eQTL, and chromatin-state evidence beyond TF peaks
assessments.rationale: ReMap retrieves TF ChIP-seq peaks and regulatory annotations, but does not cover the full evidence set requested for each variant.
